title: Action of a block coordinate permutation
statement: Let $s,w$ be natural numbers, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $\{0,\ldots,s-1\}$, and let $\tau$ be a permutation of $\{0,\ldots,w-1\}$. For every $i<s$ and $j<w$, the permutation of the $sw$ coordinates induced by applying $\sigma$ and $\tau$ to the two coordinates sends the coordinate corresponding to $(i,j)$ to the one corresponding to $(\sigma(i),\tau(j))$.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a permutation of the $s$ indices
$\tau$ is a permutation of the $w$ indices
